subject: How to read from object that model did not converge?

messages.author: 0b97ac7e902a3d34
messages.subject: How to read from object that model did not converge?
parts:
Is there a way to read from lavaan object that there were problems with convergence or appeared any errors?

I have over 50 models to test and I want to do it automatically; after using fit.model <- cfa() I would like to check if fit.model (1) converged (2) if converged, if there are any warnings. Would be great to suppress warnings/errors on output.

Any recommendations?

With all the best

MO

messages.subject: Re: How to read from object that model did not converge?
parts: Is there a way to read from lavaan object that there were problems with convergence or appeared any errors?

I use try() to check for errors.  If there were no errors, but lavaan simply did not find a solution, it will say FALSE for
lavInspect(fit, "converged")
